provenance: Original deterministic pixel-cluster artwork authored for Cinder after opening the selected G07/G18 concept images. The references guide silhouette, costume and palette; no reference pixels, concept crops or generated irregular cells are imported. The historical helmeted_lab artwork and its existing exports retain their original provenance.

api.preview: LabSprite.preview_texture(id, loadout) -> Texture2D; null for invalid identity or canonical four-slot gear

collision: The existing scenes/player.tscn capsule is unchanged; artwork is not a collider.
occlusion: Nearest-filtered billboard with ordinary world depth and the existing separate floor contact shadow.
animation_clock: The shared controller retains logical and visual action progress. Only idle breathing retains its existing 1.2 s local simulation loop. Selection rebuilds textures without resetting action/facing/frame/clock. Body pose arrays, weapon poses and exact barrel-tip pixel/world attachment controls are shared with the historical lab renderer.

equipment.implementation: All 13 currently implemented static IDs retain their canonical identity. Drawn alternatives use reinforced coat shoulders versus stitched seams, trouser pleats versus utility pockets, boot cuff/sole differences and the existing four weapon profiles. Mixed kits use the same attachment and feet conventions.

presentations.silhouette: Existing round astronaut-like shell, visor, neck seal, protective suit and pack.

presentations.inspection: Opened selected full board: Barbenfouillis expedition and front/side/back pixel studies show broad dark brim and crown, long pale beard/collar, long frock coat, dark boots and the proposed pale umbrella-inspired short blade. Ceremony's pointed hat is a separate study and is not used.
presentations.adaptation: New smaller human face under a broad stepped brim and crown, directional nose, pale split beard/collar, buttoned waistcoat and flared period-coat tails. All carried gear is translated to neutral grayscale. No helmet shell, visor, life-support pack or chest unit.

presentations.adaptation: Uncovered human head with compact tousled dark hair, directional face/ear, tapered dark travel coat, outlined diagonal pale sash, visible cuffs and separate trousers/boots. No astronaut anatomy or new weapon slot.
